market.icp: Privacy-conscious meeting participants who need local-first notes
market.buyerPain: A first-time user reaches an empty meeting library with instructions but no direct action to create the first note.
market.revenueHypothesis: A direct empty-state path into the existing consent-first workflow reduces first-run friction without adding account, provider, or billing scope.

increment.name: empty-library-first-note-cta
acceptanceCriteria: When no local meetings exist, the rendered empty state links to #new-meeting.
The link is labelled Create your first meeting note.
The CTA reuses existing SideNote primary-link styling and introduces no new CSS or dependency.
The filtered no-results state keeps its existing Clear filters recovery action.
TypeScript, the persistent DOM contract, and the production build pass locally.
LICENSE, dependency manifests, credentials, providers, billing, and deployment configuration remain unchanged.

delivery.checker: Codex separate local verification; independent checker unavailable in this single-agent slice
evidence: Production bundle copy and target inspection
delivery.rollback: Revert only the empty-library CTA commit on feat/sidenote-meeting-goal.
delivery.stopCondition: Stop after one verified empty-state increment; do not merge, deploy, submit to an app store, spend, change credentials, or change licensing.
